SELECT 
	SaleTemplateCode=H.SaleTemplateCode, 
	Template = H.Name,
	GroupCode = G.GroupCode,
	GroupName = G.GroupName,
	ICode=D.ICode,
	packunits = I.PackUnits,
	SalePrice = ROUND((I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END), 2),
	unitsalestax = ROUND((I.PackSalesTax / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END), 2),
	GstPerc  = I.GstPerc1,
	Stock = ISNULL(SUM(GD.CurrQty), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty), 0),
	LooseQty = ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty), 0),
	NetQty = ISNULL(SUM(GD.CurrQty), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty), 0),
	PrefferedSaleQty=I.PrefferedSaleQty,
	InvCount = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SaleInvCode) FROM SaleTemplateDetail STD WHERE STD.SaleTemplateCode = :ai_templatecode)
FROM 
	SaleTemplateHeader H, 
	(SELECT SaleTemplateCode, ICode, LooseQty=SUM(LooseQty)
	FROM SaleTemplateDetail 
	WHERE SaleTemplateCode = :ai_templatecode
	GROUP BY SaleTemplateCode, ICode
	UNION
	SELECT SaleTemplateCode=:ai_templatecode, I.ICode, LooseQty=0.0000
	FROM Item I
	WHERE 
		CASE :as_group
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode 
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode 
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode 
			ELSE I.PackCode END = :ai_groupcode AND
		I.ICode NOT IN (SELECT ICode FROM SaleTemplateDetail WHERE SaleTemplateCode=:ai_templatecode)) D,
	Item I,
	(SELECT GroupCode = ManfCode, GroupName = Name
	FROM Manufacturer
	WHERE :as_group = 'M'  AND ManfCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT GroupCode = ICatCode, GroupName = Name
	FROM ItemCategory
	WHERE :as_group = 'C'  AND ICatCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT GroupCode = ICCode, GroupName = Name
	FROM ItemClass
	WHERE :as_group = 'L'  AND ICCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT GroupCode = PackCode, GroupName = Name
	FROM ItemPacking
	WHERE :as_group = 'P'  AND PackCode = :ai_groupcode) G,
	GodownDetail GD
WHERE 
	H.SaleTemplateCode = :ai_templatecode AND
	H.SaleTemplateCode = D.SaleTemplateCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.ICode = GD.ICode AND
	GD.ICode = D.ICode AND
	G.GroupCode = 
		CASE :as_group
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode 
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode 
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode 
			ELSE I.PackCode END
GROUP BY
	H.SaleTemplateCode,
	H.Name,
	G.GroupCode,
	G.GroupName,
	D.ICode,
	GD.ICode,
	I.SalePrice,
	I.PackUnits,
	I.PrefferedSaleQty,
	I.PackSalesTax,
	I.GstPerc1
HAVING  (ISNULL(SUM(GD.CurrQty), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty), 0)) > 0 AND ( I.PrefferedSaleQty <= (ISNULL(SUM(GD.CurrQty), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty), 0)) )
